svg.title: Green and Red
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and standardized vivid colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. Green rounded canopy/stem-like painted figure on red field with white paper margin. Brushed texture omitted; all colors observed in Sotheby image.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.sothebys.com/en/buy/auction/2025/contemporary-day-auction/green-and-red; record sothebys-en-buy-auction-2025-contemporary-day-auction-green-and-red; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
